description: Procedure for Importation and Supply of Food-Grade Maize to M/s Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited.
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-03-03 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited has to use imported maize due to the inability to meet sufficient stocks of maize with required standards domestically for the production of Thriposha. However, as maize importation is subject to multiple regulatory controls including the Import Control Licenses and Plant Import Permits, a methodology needs to be introduced to import high quality maize without disruption and delay, enabling to continue the production of Thriposha. Accordingly, the Secretary, Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation and the Secretary, Ministry of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development have prepared a procedure for importation of maize required for Sri Lanka Thriposha Limited for the production of Thriposha and related products in a phased out manner, adhering to the relevant procurement guidelines and regulatory requirements. The joint proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation; and the Minister of Trade, Commerce, Food Security and Cooperative Development to import a maximum of 15,000 metric tons of maize in a phased manner for the production of Thriposha for the year 2026 following the said procedure, was approved by the Cabinet.
